title: nan
authors: Chen Z.; Zhou J.; Gao D.; Lin J.; Huang G.; Deng Z.
key_contribution: Presents a UAV scene matching method combining triplet relationships and sliding mode control for positioning in GPS-denied environments, with extensive experimental validation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
